rules.title: HRPC file top-level structure
rules.statement: file := package_def? import_def* top_def* — an HRPC source file is an optional single package declaration, followed by zero+ imports, followed by zero+ top-level definitions, in that order.

rules.title: Package declaration
rules.statement: package_def := 'package' qualified_name ';' — at most one package declaration per file (production is optional, non-repeating).

rules.title: Import declaration
rules.statement: import_def := 'import' STRING ';' — import path is a string literal.

rules.title: Option declaration
rules.statement: option_def := 'option' IDENT '=' option_value ';' where option_value := STRING | INTEGER | IDENT. Options may appear at top level and inside message bodies.

rules.title: Top-level definition kinds
rules.statement: top_def := message_def | enum_def | service_def | option_def — the four item kinds permitted at file scope.

rules.title: Message definition
rules.statement: message_def := 'message' IDENT '{' message_body* '}' where message_body := field_def | oneof_def | enum_def | message_def | option_def. Messages nest (message/enum may appear inside a message body).

rules.title: Message field definition
rules.statement: field_def := field_label? type_ref IDENT '=' INTEGER ';' where field_label := 'optional' | 'required' | 'repeated'. Every field carries an explicit numeric tag; the label is optional.

rules.title: Oneof definition
rules.statement: oneof_def := 'oneof' IDENT '{' oneof_field* '}'; oneof_field := type_ref IDENT '=' INTEGER ';'. Oneof members are unlabeled tagged fields and may not nest other oneofs/messages.

rules.title: Enum definition
rules.statement: enum_def := 'enum' IDENT '{' enum_value_def* '}'; enum_value_def := IDENT '=' INTEGER ';'. Each enum value binds a name to an explicit integer.

rules.title: Service definition
rules.statement: service_def := 'service' IDENT '{' rpc_def* '}' — a service body contains zero+ rpc method declarations only.

rules.title: RPC method declaration
rules.statement: rpc_def := 'rpc' IDENT '(' rpc_type ')' 'returns' '(' rpc_type ')' ';' — each method has exactly one input and one output rpc_type.

rules.title: Streaming RPC type
rules.statement: rpc_type := 'stream' type_ref | type_ref — an rpc input or output may be marked streaming with the 'stream' keyword prefix.

rules.title: Type reference
rules.statement: type_ref := 'map' '<' type_ref ',' type_ref '>' | qualified_name — a type is either a map with key and value type arguments or a qualified name; maps may nest.

rules.title: Dotted qualified name
rules.statement: qualified_name := IDENT ('.' IDENT)* — a non-empty dot-separated sequence of identifier components.
